description.value: Mambo Gourmet Pizza is a second-generation family-owned Nanaimo institution that has been handcrafting pan pizzas since 1995, voted best pizza in Nanaimo for 13 consecutive years. The menu spans classic and specialty pies, build-your-own options, and an extra-large 18" format that can be split four ways across different recipes. Vegan and gluten-free options are available, and both indoor and outdoor seating is on offer.
